events.did: 六点前起床跑三英里、洗五分钟冷水澡、在门廊上默默喝一杯意式浓缩
events.quote_anchor: He still rose before six to run three miles, still took a cold five-minute shower, still drank an espresso in silence on the porch.

events.did: 在去 EON 的车上翻看座位袋里的平板，查看病人和工作人员的情况
events.quote_anchor: he flicked through the tablet in the seat pocket, checking on his patients, then his staff.

events.did: 在 Gabriel 查房时记下笔记，把他的想法抄下来以备后用
events.quote_anchor: As he did his morning rounds, she took notes, transcribing his thoughts for later reference.

events.did: 抬头跟在 Gabriel 后面走进 Control
events.quote_anchor: Noah looked up—eyes hidden, as usual, behind his sunglasses— and followed him into Control.

events.did: 命令 Helena 派最近的特遣员去调查三名新候选人的所在位置
events.quote_anchor: “Helena,” instructed Gabriel, “please dispatch the closest agents to investigate.”

events.did: 举手制止 Noah 跟过去，让他留在原地
events.quote_anchor: Noah began to follow, but Gabriel held up a hand. “Stay here.”

events.did: 把手掌按在扫描仪上，让门解锁并走进房间所在的走廊
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel laid his palm against the scanner, and the doors unsealed, letting him pass into the corridor

events.did: 对房间里的患者打招呼，说“Hello, Eli”“Welcome back”
events.quote_anchor: “Hello, Eli,” he said in a warm, patient tone. “Welcome back.”

relations.did: 与 Helena Roy 的关系：没有她的引荐他不会被邀请加入 EON，只能当治疗师
relations.quote_anchor: Without her intercession, Gabriel would never have been invited into EON. At least, not as a therapist.

relations.did: 与 Noah 的关系：他要求这个特遣员信任自己，Noah 回答“Of course I do”
relations.quote_anchor: The EO’s jaw tensed, almost imperceptibly, but there was no tension in the tether when he said, “Of course I do.”

relations.did: 与 Malcolm 的关系：Malcolm 是他的病人，被接进系统为 EON 工作
relations.quote_anchor: Malcolm’s only glitch was that he could no longer disconnect, no longer act or speak outside the system.

relations.did: 与 Eli（患者 32）的关系：读过他的档案，早就认定他是 EON 停尸房里的宝贝
relations.quote_anchor: He’d been waiting for this moment since he read the EO’s dossier, and realized what a gem lay housed in EON’s morgue

numbers.quote_anchor: He still rose before six to run three miles

numbers.did: 冷水澡只洗五分钟（five-minute shower）
numbers.quote_anchor: still took a cold five-minute shower, still drank an espresso in silence on the porch

numbers.did: 永远早到五分钟（five minutes early）
numbers.quote_anchor: His driver, Evanson, always five minutes early, because that was how he’d been instructed.

numbers.did: 几个月前（months ago）被复活，至今没有苏醒的迹象
numbers.quote_anchor: Take Dominic, who, despite the fact he’d been resurrected months ago, had shown no signs of waking up.

numbers.did: 走进病人房间前，门外站着两名卫兵（a pair of guards）
numbers.quote_anchor: A pair of guards stood at attention in the hall outside the chamber.
